g.text: TOOLS: no kmerseek; Pfam-A 38.2 seed pairs; BLOSUM62 and PairwiseAligner from Biopython
Of the 28 Pfam pairs an exact H/P run certifies and the ungapped BLOSUM62 segment does not, a gapped aligner
Hypothesis: If these pairs were out of reach of sequence alignment, the filled circles would stay under the line.
Conclusion: 17 of 28 reach 24 bits with gapped Smith-Waterman; 11 do not: HH_RND_rel, PPP1R35_C, DUF6955,
YIL152W_C, DUF6722, DUF8304, MPI_cupin_dom, DUF19, Por_Secre_tail, KH_1, CTE_SPB4.
